# preflight-integration-tester

> Pre-alpha AI-readiness diagnostic — tests data and integration paths for pilot-purgatory risk before enterprise AI deployment.

preflight-integration-tester is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).
